ctx.x: The trouble I had to get back to America. The trouble that she had in the incident that happened concerning the Guild, she was executive of a Guild -- Negro Actors Guild. She was executive of that Guild at the time and some funds got misappropriated and she was found to be guilty of it and I know it was a set up because one of the guys, his safe was busted and he had to get a safe man to unlock the safe and he fixed it so she wouldn't be able to get the safe open and he took some things -- fixed it so she…

So she came and I asked her, did she have everything straight, she said yes. She hadn't been in San Francisco one week before the news was out and they were looking for her. So when I got the wind of it, I talked her into going back to New York -- don't let them pick her up here. Go back to New York, it's better for you.
